name: OCRBench
intro: OCRBench是一个综合性评估基准，旨在评估大型多模态模型的光学字符识别（OCR）能力。它包含29个数据集，涵盖文本识别、场景文本视觉问答、文档视觉问答、关键信息提取和手写数学表达式识别等任务。该基准包含1000个经过人工验证和校正的问题-答案对，以确保评估的准确性。研究揭示了模型在处理多语言文本、手写文本、非语义文本和数学表达式识别方面的优势和劣势。
org: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Microsoft Research, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Chinese Academy of Sciences, South China University of Technology
build_method: 数据集整合, 人工筛选与校正, 任务专属提示
task_type: 视觉问答, 文本识别, 关键信息提取
scale: 1,000个问答对；29个来源数据集；5类任务
task_type_en: Visual QA, text recognition, key information extraction
build_method_en: Dataset Integration, Manual Filtering and Correction, Task-specific Prompting
intro_en: OCRBench is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark designed to assess the optical character recognition (OCR) capabilities of large multimodal models. It includes 29 datasets covering tasks such as text recognition, scene text visual question answering, document visual question answering, key information extraction, and handwritten mathematical expression recognition. The benchmark contains 1,000 manually verified and corrected question-answer pairs to ensure evaluation accuracy. Studies reveal the models' strengths and weaknesses in handling multilingual text, handwritten text, non-semantic text, and mathematical expression recognition.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.07895 Sections 3.1 and 3.3 and Appendix A plus the official Yuliang-Liu/MultimodalOCR repository. The diagrams distinguish the broad 29-dataset study from the compact 1,000-item OCRBench release, retain the IIIT5K-based 3,000-image semantic/non-semantic controls and broad-pool filtering of answers shorter than four symbols, preserve task-specific English, Chinese, digit, KIE, and LaTeX prompts, and encode the exact final composition: 300 recognition items across six 50-item types, 200 scene-text VQA items across four 50-item sources, 200 document VQA items across four 50-item sources, 200 KIE items split 67/66/67 across SROIE/FUNSD/POIE, and 100 HME100K HMER items. All 1,000 answers are manually verified and corrected with alternatives, and scoring checks gold-answer containment before summing five component counts to a maximum of 1,000.
